statement: For every array arr' of the same length with all elements in [1, 100000] such that for every i, j with 0 <= i < len(arr) and 0 <= j < len(arr), arr[i] = arr[j] if and only if arr'[i] = arr'[j], whenever get_distances(arr) returns r and get_distances(arr') returns r', we have len(r) = len(r') and for every i with 0 <= i < len(arr), r[i] = r'[i].
